## 🎓 Learning Path

### Beginner Path
1. [QUICK_START.md](QUICK_START.md) - Get set up
2. Try code snippets - Type `contract` + Tab
3. Run a task - `Ctrl+Shift+P` → "Tasks"
4. Ask Copilot - `Ctrl+I` for inline chat

### Intermediate Path
1. [DEVELOPMENT_GUIDE.md](DEVELOPMENT_GUIDE.md) - Full workflow

### Advanced Path

2. Modify tasks - Edit `tasks.json`
3. Add launch configs - Edit `launch.json`
4. Extend documentation
